note: G3a (docs/276 §5.2, docs/222 §11.5): the go-live stack priced at runtime from one snapshot per world. TIMING, NEEDS A QUIET MACHINE (clean night); RUN FIRST: a rewind pilot that reaches >= 80% accepted rewinds on BP (rewind-pilot-1116-1116b or its rerun on the bridge with docs/270 §31). Bin state apex-rewind (node tools/harness/queue-rewind.ts state <this file>; Apex latest + the patched RTX Remix bridge). Two rewind groups (BP, IP), 14 jobs each = 7 pairs in ABBA order (off-1 on-1 | on-2 off-2 | ...); every job of a group has the same game start key, the arms differ only in profile.fixesOff (autshadow,autlive,autunseen off at runtime: no go-live requests, no worker, no consume, no unseen-direct; read back by profile-world.ts). The first job of each group loads fresh and the queue snapshots after the load; the other 13 start from a rewind with seed 12345, so each segment starts from the same memory image. A refused rewind reloads and starts a new snapshot epoch: tools/harness/g3-report.ts voids pairs across epochs and pairs with a high-noise row. Read: node tools/harness/g3-report.ts probe-out/queue/g3a-rewind-1116-<date>.jsonl (paired on - off it/s and ms/s, mean +- sd over valid pairs, >= 6 valid pairs per world; G3b installed-only price from the on rows). What this cannot price (installed at load, not switchable at runtime): the kAutLive hooks (B14, push, enqueue, choose pass-through frames), native guard thunks (Guard=all), the AutShadow managed hook set (in every package, also the release state), anything an ini Mode key installs; G3b prices the first two from counters. Household: no behaviour change (the off arm runs fewer of our features, the on arm the shipped defaults, each exempting the household). ~2 x (14 x ~4.3 min + ~2 min load) = ~2.1 h with the smoke. Start: node tools/harness/queue.ts tools/harness/queues/g3a-rewind-1116.json
